description: Payback period and three year net for automating a repetitive task. Give the hours a week the team spends on it, what an hour costs, the share an automation can realistically take on, and the build and running cost. The same sum as the free calculator at shurco.ai. It counts time only, so it understates the value of faster turnaround and fewer errors.

hourly_cost.description: Cost of one hour of that work, salary plus employer costs.

hours_per_week.description: Hours a week the team spends on the task, everyone added together.

monthly_running_cost.description: Running cost a month, including model usage, hosting, monitoring and upkeep.

share_percent.description: Share of the work an automation can take on, 0 to 100. Real systems range from about 60 to 90.

name: automation_roi
title: Work out whether an automation pays back
